draft.title: Leaders of the revolution
card: A lawyer and powerful speaker who helped form the Paris Commune's radical politics in 1792. He joined the first Committee of Public Safety in 1793, later argued for an end to the harsh measures, and was executed in April 1794.
A journalist whose paper, L'Ami du peuple, attacked the king, nobles and officials he saw as enemies of the people. Charlotte Corday, who opposed the Jacobins, stabbed him in July 1793.
A lawyer and Jacobin who sat on the Committee of Public Safety from July 1793. He pushed for the Terror as a way to defend the republic and its virtue.
In July 1794 the Convention turned on Robespierre. He was arrested and guillotined, and the Terror ended soon after.
draft.remember: All three pushed the radical revolution, but only Robespierre drove the Terror until it destroyed him.

a.q: Which statement about Robespierre is correct?
opts: He drove the Terror and was executed in July 1794
He was killed by Charlotte Corday in July 1793
He was executed in April 1794 for urging less harshness
He led the Paris Commune and wrote L'Ami du peuple
a.why: Robespierre was on the Committee of Public Safety, pushed the Terror and was guillotined in July 1794 after the Convention turned on him. The Corday option describes Marat, and the April 1794 option describes Danton.
a.clue: Think of who was on the Committee and who fell after the Convention turned on him.

b.q: In early 1794 a deputy argues that the harsh measures have gone far enough and should ease. He is arrested and executed that April. Which leader does this describe?
b.why: Danton called for an end to the harsh measures and was executed in April 1794. Marat was already dead, killed in July 1793. Robespierre drove the Terror and fell in July 1794.
b.clue: Who was already dead by 1794, and who pushed the Terror on?

a.best: He drove the Terror and was executed in July 1794

check.summary: No problems found. The dates and roles for Danton, Marat and Robespierre check out, and both questions have one clear right answer that matches the card and the explanations.
